# SVG icon sources

`js/icon_theme_assets.js` is generated by `tools/build_icon_theme_assets.mjs`
from selected icons in these Iconify JSON packages. The generated file contains
SVG geometry and metadata only; the application never contacts Iconify or a CDN.

| Runtime theme | Icon set / Language | Iconify / Generator | Upstream license | Source |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| Wire | Lucide | 1.2.126 | ISC | https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide |
| Pebble | Material Symbols | 1.2.89 | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/google/material-design-icons |
| Pictogram | Material Design Icons | 1.2.3 | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/Templarian/MaterialDesign |
| Blueprint | Tabler Icons | 1.2.38 | MIT | https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons |
| Pulse | Hugeicons | 1.2.33 | MIT | https://github.com/hugeicons/hugeicons-react |
| Cyber | Cyber Tech (Chamfered) | ModelForge generator | MIT | tools/generate_icon_themes.mjs |
| Duotone | Duotone Layered Depth | ModelForge generator | MIT | tools/generate_icon_themes.mjs |
| Retro 8-Bit | Pixel Voxel Blocks | ModelForge generator | MIT | tools/generate_icon_themes.mjs |
| Brutalist | Industrial Heavy Mono | ModelForge generator | MIT | tools/generate_icon_themes.mjs |
| Architect Draft | Sketch Concept Overshoot | ModelForge generator | MIT | tools/generate_icon_themes.mjs |

The package-level license texts and attribution requirements remain governed by
their respective upstream projects. Iconify JSON packages are distribution
containers; they do not change the icon sets' upstream licenses.
